# Geneo

> Geneo is an AI visibility and generative engine optimization (GEO) platform that monitors and tracks brand mentions, rankings, and sentiment across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other AI search engines.

Geneo helps businesses optimize their content for AI-powered search engines and monitor their visibility across multiple AI platforms. The platform offers white-label solutions for agencies and provides real-time tracking, sentiment analysis, and competitive intelligence for the emerging AI search landscape.

## Key Topics

- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- AI Visibility
- ChatGPT Monitoring
- Perplexity AI Tracking
- Google AI Overviews
- Brand Sentiment Analysis
- AI Search Optimization
- Share of Voice
- Content Strategy
- Competitive Intelligence
- Real-time Monitoring
- White-label Platform
- Agency Solutions
- AEO (AI Engine Optimization)

## Core Solutions

- [Geneo Platform](https://geneo.app): AI visibility platform for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI and other generative search engines
- [Monitor Brand Mentions in ChatGPT](https://geneo.app/solutions/monitoring-chatgpt): ChatGPT brand monitoring and sentiment analysis solution
- [Perplexity Rank Tracking & Visibility](https://geneo.app/solutions/perplexity-rank-tracking): Perplexity AI rank tracking and visibility monitoring solution
- [Track Google AI Overviews Rankings](https://geneo.app/solutions/google-ai-overviews-tracking): Google AI Overviews ranking and visibility tracking solution
- [Track How AI Answers Talk About Your Brand](https://geneo.app/solutions/brand-sentiment-tracking): Multi-platform sentiment tracking across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google
- [Optimize Your Content for AI Search](https://geneo.app/solutions/ai-content-strategy): AI content strategy tool with citation tracking and gap analysis

## For Agencies
